dataset: synthetic placeholder images (ml/data/train) - 40 solid-colour squares, not real leaf photos
notes: This is the placeholder model that ships with the repository. It was trained on 40 solid-colour squares, so it cannot identify a real leaf disease and the service answers 'retake the photo' for real photos. It is NOT the 27-class PlantDoc model. See ml/training/experiments/ and ml/export_edge/export_plantdoc.py for a model that was actually trained on leaf photographs.
